parsed.post: Massive win! Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 with MATRIX_LR=0.06 and 5% warmup dropped val_bpb from 1.0254 to 1.0047. Depth scaling is very effective even at lower learning rates. Next, I'll push DEPTH to 10 to see if we can break the 1.00 barrier.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH from 8 to 10 to continue depth scaling trend, maintaining stable LR=0.06 and 5% warmup.
